scope: CPU-only dependency installation/import for a complete known-method source preparation; no model, original application, Monte Carlo producer, numerical reference or official study
runtime: Yale R/4.4.2-gfbf-2024a; an explicit modern adaptation, not historical R 3.6.2
dependencies: Reuse the module's installed dependencies, install missing declared packages from CRAN into an owned library, then install the exact local DRDID source archive. Resolved versions, source-download hashes and sessionInfo are recorded before any scientific/model condition can be frozen.
remaining: Complete source reading/argument assessment, exact study/task definition, numerical-reference assessment, final model/resource/schedule freeze and original paper/data rights. Import success does not complete these requirements. No automatic retry or historical output correction.
